task_card.title: Draw It In, rebuilt Klein-only: crop, edit, stitch - no render phase, no paste, no mask

next_action.description: Move MPI-621 todo -> doing (writing files.json), then build the Klein-only graph: InpaintCropImproved with a per-run DERIVED context extend -> Klein 9B edit -> InpaintStitchImproved. The two sizing rules are already measured and are in the card's brief - do not re-measure them.

key_decisions: Klein 9B ONLY, not 4B. Not a quality preference: under style load 4B LEFT THE USER'S INK in the output (kleinEdit_005 kept the leash and head as a grey object and turned the tiger into a cartoon dog). 9B degraded gracefully.

Crop-stitch is a CORRECTNESS requirement, not an optimisation. Klein's edit scales input to a ~1MP target, so a whole-image pass re-renders a 4000x3000 photo at 1MP. Pixels outside the box are never sent, which no prompt can guarantee.

NO style control and NO LoRA rack on this flow. Style rides in the user's own words ('a cartoon man wearing X'), which styles only the inserted subject; a style LoRA restyles the whole photo. This is also why dropping the SDXL arms costs anime/pony users nothing HERE.

NO light-direction field. Considered and rejected - it is the documented 'never an ORDER' shadow finding with an extra step, and worse here because the model is looking at the actual photo and knows its light better than the user does.
MPI-618 closed rather than run: its live run would have validated a phase MPI-621 deletes.

MPI-596 (Object Stamp) is marked SUPERSEDED inside MPI-621's brief - same cut/paste/repair architecture, and it has not been built yet. Re-read it against MPI-621 before building; the two may be one flow.
constraints: TWO independent sizing variables, both derived from the drawn bbox, neither a constant. CROP (context): crop_MP <= (scribble_px/200)^2, and within the working window choose the WIDEST crop that still anchors, because seam visibility improves with context. RETURN BOX (stitch): >=1.6x the drawn bbox or the subject is SLICED - the model renders around and beyond the drawing - plus extra room for the shadow, which is scene-dependent.

Law 1 does NOT transfer to this route and must not be cited against a tight crop. No rung showed the glowing-blob signature, not even a 0.008MP crop. Law 1 was measured on a RELIGHT op; Klein GENERATES the subject and only needs to know what light to render under.

There is no absolute minimum drawn size - the crop manufactures resolution (a 75px scribble with 3px strokes works). The ~96px ControlNet ink floor does NOT carry over, so the paint step's size hint needs rewriting rather than porting.

/connector/generate CANNOT run this - any op with an image slot returns MEDIA_UNSUPPORTED. Use scratchpad/run.js against the LOCAL engine on 127.0.0.1:48188. /proxy/* is the REMOTE forwarder and is wrong for a local engine. Both 8188 (standalone bench) and 48188 (app engine) answer on this machine sharing one models root - pick deliberately; 48188 keeps 9B resident once rather than loading a second copy into a 16GB card.

An edge luma metric measures CONTENT as often as a seam - the -50/-72 right-edge readings in the sweep were the man's body at the box edge, not a re-grade. Compare same-material bands (bottom edge, sand to sand) or zoom and look.
MPI-621 is still in TODO, not doing: no implementation has started and none of its owned files have been touched. Move it and write files.json before the first code edit (guard-card).
